text.description_html:
ADA Compliant Polished Brass Commercial Storeroom Door Lever

The GAL standard design commercial entry levers are heavy duty Grade 2 with Vandal Resistant free wheeling Clutch mechanism.

Complies with ANSI/BHMA A156.4, Series 4000, Grade 2. Listed by UL / ULC for ratings of A label (3 hours) and less, UL10C / UBC 7-2 (1997) positive pressure, for single doors up to 4'0" x 8'0"

These ADA compliant levers (conform to A117.1 Barrier Free Accessibility Code) are solid cast and fully adjustable for 1-3/8" to 1-7/8" thick doors. They also conform to California Code title 19.

These ADA Compliant Commercial Levers also available in other functions and finishes.

Storeroom Lever Function (F86): Lockset for exterior/interior door applications that latch by inside lever. Outside lever is always ridge. Use key outside to retract latch. Inside lever always unlocked.

Specifications:

  • Door Thickness: Adjustable for 1-3/8" to 1-7/8" thick.
  • Door Prep: Fits standard 161 door prep.
  • Backsets: Standard 2-3/4", Optional 2-3/8"
  • Case: Steel, Zinc dichromated resists corrosion, heavy duty spring cage.
  • Thru-bolted: 5/16" holes outside 2-1/8" bore for anti-rotation.
  • Strike: 4-7/8" X 1-1/4", curved lip (Standard ASA).
  • Latchbolt: 5/8" throw stainless steel 3 hour UL rated.
  • Handing: Non-handed.
  • Trim: "L" Eiffel levers.
  • Keyways: SC1 "C" Standard.
  • Cylinder: Brass 6-pin cylinder keyed to 6-pins.
  • Vandal Resistant: Clutch free wheeling mechanism.
  • Finish: Polished Brass
  • Function: Storeroom (ANSI# F86)
